top_signals.title: Asian Shares Rise as Fed Bets Ease, Euro Drops: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Asian stocks rose along with Treasuries as oil prices declined and softer US jobs data reduced pressure on the Federal Reserve to keep raising interest rates. The euro extended its drop against the dollar.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: U.S. accuses California woman of spying for China and surveilling Taiwan leader’s son
top_signals.summary: U.S. officials say Wanying Zhang used tradecraft to avoid detection and never notified Washington that she was acting for a foreign government.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Facebook whistleblower Frances Haugen questions whether AI companies can police themselves
